defects.what: The paper held in the lower left of the lens view is covered in rows of CJK-like pseudo-glyphs.
Two wrong flags: a blue-and-red flag with a yellow emblem and no white triangle at the bottom-panel window, and a red flag with a cross on the pole of the stone house at top right.
The still is a collage of tilted photo cards (houses, a wall, close-ups of eyes) rather than one picture.
The deed page shows a large pseudo-text heading, mixed Latin/CJK pseudo-text lines and a glyph signature block.
The notebook page shows a column of large numbers instead of tally marks.
A large anime face with staring eyes is drawn inside the glass tower at mid-height, where the prompt calls for no people.
The young man is drawn twice (one walking out of the door at left, one standing behind Lola), and neither has Indio's topknot.
The young man on the right has loose brown hair, no topknot and a cream short-sleeved shirt, so he does not read as Indio.
The dog at lower left has no red kerchief (a white collar instead) and a pug-like face, so it does not read as Usman.
The dog in the foreground wears a white collar instead of the red kerchief and has two upright ears.
The bronze coin held in the centre has pseudo-text lettering stamped around its rim.
The motorcycle fuel tank carries a script brand-like word.
Indio's red headband has white glyph-like symbols printed on the front.
Indio's red headband has a white logo-like emblem printed on its front.
The leaping Usman has two huge upright ears instead of one folded ear.
Indio wears a dark tunic, shorts and slippers instead of his outfit, and the dog has two upright ears.
A poster with pseudo-text lines hangs on the wall in the top-left corner.
The storefronts at lower left carry small pseudo-text signs.
